Blue Jays Lose Two Games to Athletics in Series

The Toronto Blue Jays lost two games to the Oakland Athletics in a series. In one game, the Athletics won 2-0, blanking the Blue Jays. In another game, the Athletics defeated the Blue Jays 4-2, with home runs hit by Okamoto and Smith.
